messages.subject: incomplete surveyReport-not getting detection maps nor activity
parts:
Hello
I am trying to use surveyReport, for which it is indicated:
If makezip is TRUE, a zip file will be created in sinkpath. It contains single-species activity plots, detection maps (if Xcol and Ycol are defined), the survey report tables, the record table and the camera trap station table, and an example R script.
But I don t get any maps nor activity plots, just events csvs (e.g. _by_species, station etc) and the scripts folder.
Am I doing something wrong and could anyone provide advice on how to solve it?
This is the code
#I ll need 1) data extracted from CT, 2) CT a csv including coordinates and dates
#to make sure that you have a clean R environment
rm(list = ls())

setwd("~/Desktop/sn_analysis_test")
list.files()

library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

# read in the data
dat <- read.csv("r1sn.csv")
table(dat$Station)
?select
dat <- select(dat, Station, DateTimeOriginal, Date, Time, metadata_2Species, metadata_3Nindividuals, metadata_1Trail)
names(dat)[5:7] <- c("Species","N","Trail")

#-----to include the effort and coordinates for each CT
CT <- read_xlsx("effortlatlon2.xlsx")
CT
CT <- select(CT, x, y, Station, Start_Date, End_Date, effort)
names(CT) <- c("x", "y", "Station", "start_date","end_date","Effort")

# merge the data
dat.all <- left_join(dat, CT, by="Station")
dat.all
dat
######################################
###### General Reporting
######################################
library(camtrapR)
?surveyReport
report <- surveyReport (dat, #record table data
                        CT, #CT table data
                        speciesCol = "Species",
                        cameraCol = "Station",
                        setupCol = "start_date",
                        retrievalCol = "end_date",
                        CTDateFormat = "%Y-%m-%d",
                        recordDateTimeCol = "DateTimeOriginal",
                        recordDateTimeFormat = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
                        Xcol = "x",
                        Ycol = "y",
                        sinkpath= getwd(),
                        makezip = TRUE
                       
)

Thanks a lot, best regards

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: incomplete surveyReport-not getting detection maps nor activity
parts:
Hi,
thank you for the feedback and good to hear it is solved.

Regarding the other points:
  • camop warning, I changed the internal workings of the surveyReport function a while back and it calculates effort more precisely if you give a camera operation matrix. If camop is not provided the calculation may be a little less precise (e.g. counting setup and retrieval day as full days).
  • zip package: as you said, it was probably already installed since you got a zip file already.
  • plots on top of plots. I've never seen this before and have no idea what is going on. Does this happen with any call to plot(), or only with the camtrapR functions?

Best regards

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: incomplete surveyReport-not getting detection maps nor activity
parts:
Yes, possibly an R or RStudio issue, maybe specific to Mac. I don't know what causes it. Updating RStudio and R is always worth a try.

You may be able to prevent this issue by calling dev.off() between plots. It closes the current plot and resets the graphics device.
